q: Aziz is watching a movie on TV where cowboys ride horses in the wild west of America.
why: «cowboys ride horses in the wild west» iborasi bu janrning kovboylar haqidagi «western» ekanligini bildiradi.

wrong.action film: Jangari kino. Matnda otliq kovboylar va g'arbiy hududlar haqida aytilgan.
wrong.horror film: Qo'rqinchli kino. Bu yerda qo'rqinchli voqealar emas, kovboylar haqida ketmoqda.
wrong.musical: myuzikl. Bu yerda qo'shiq va raqslar haqida so'z borayotgani yo'q.

q: Jasur learned a lot about wild lions and elephants from this real-life TV program.
why: «real-life TV program» va sherlar haqidagi ma'lumot «documentary» ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.chat show: tok-shou. Mashhur mehmonlar bilan suhbat, tabiat haqida emas.
wrong.game show: o'yin shousi. Bu yerda bilim beruvchi film haqida ketmoqda.
wrong.sitcom: sitkom. Hazilga boy kulgili serial ma'nosini bildiradi.

q: The story takes place in a magical world with dragons, elves, and wizards.
why: «magical world with dragons» ifodasi bu «fantasy film» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.science fiction film: ilmiy-fantastik kino. Sehrgarlar emas, kelajak yoki kosmos haqida bo'ladi.
wrong.war film: urush filmi. Sehrli olamni emas, harbiy harakatlarni ko'rsatadi.
wrong.period drama: tarixiy drama. Sehrgarlar emas, o'tmish hayotini tasvirlaydi.

q: The actors sing and dance through every scene in this bright, joyful movie.
why: «sing and dance through every scene» so'zlari bu «musical» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.action film: jangari kino. Raqs va qo'shiqlar bilan bog'liq emas.
wrong.documentary: hujjatli film. Haqiqiy voqealarni tushuntiradi, qo'shiqqa boy emas.
wrong.western: vesterin. Kovboylar haqidagi filmlar uchun ishlatiladi.

q: Bobur watched the TV anchor present the latest global events and political updates.
why: «latest global events and political updates» bu «news bulletin» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.chat show: tok-shou. Siyosiy yangiliklar emas, suhbatlar uyushtiriladi.
wrong.weather forecast: ob-havo ma'lumoti. Faqat havo sharoitini ko'rsatadi.

q: Dilshod loves watching regular people try to survive on a deserted island together.
why: «regular people try to survive on a deserted island» bu «reality show» ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.sitcom: sitkom. Odamlar orolda emas, kulgili vaziyatdagi uyda yashaydi.

q: Zarina enjoys funny TV series where the same characters get into silly situations every week.
why: «funny TV series» va «silly situations» bu «sitcom» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.soap opera: sovunli opera. Kulgili emas, ko'pincha dramatik bo'ladi.
wrong.documentary: hujjatli film. Haqiqiy ma'lumot beradi, kulgili serial emas.
wrong.news bulletin: yangiliklar byulleteni. Hazil va kulgili vaziyatlar bo'lmaydi.

q: Otabek watched singers and dancers compete on stage to win the main prize.
why: «singers and dancers compete on stage» bu «talent show» ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.game show: o'yin shousi. San'atkorlar emas, bilimdonlar raqobatlashadi.
wrong.sitcom: sitkom. Kulgili serial bo'lib, sahnadagi tanlov emas.

q: Nargiza checked the TV screen to see if she needed an umbrella for tomorrow.
why: «needed an umbrella for tomorrow» bu «weather forecast» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.news bulletin: yangiliklar. Siyosiy voqealar haqida bo'lib, soyabon haqida emas.
wrong.documentary: hujjatli film. Ob-havoni oldindan aytib bermaydi.

q: The main ______ of the movie was so unexpected that everyone in the cinema was shocked.
why: «unexpected» so'zi kutilmagan «ending» (oxiri) haqida ketayotganini bildiradi.

q: I found the book rather ______ because nothing exciting happened from start to finish.
why: «nothing exciting happened» so'zlari kitobning zerikarli «boring» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.exciting: ajoyib, qiziqarli. Aksincha, voqea yo'qligini bildiradi.
wrong.gripping: o'ziga rom etuvchi. Zerikarli so'ziga zid.
wrong.funny: kulgili. Kitobning zerikarli ekaniga mos kelmaydi.

q: The explanation given by the teacher was very ______ and left the students with many questions.
why: «left the students with many questions» bu tushunarsiz «confusing» ekanini bildiradi.

q: Her performance as a detective was completely ______; I really believed she was a real police officer.
why: «I really believed she was a real» bu ishonchli «convincing» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

q: It was so ______ when he forgot his lines in front of the whole school during the play.
why: «forgot his lines in front of the whole school» bu uyatli «embarrassing» vaziyatdir.

wrong.funny: kulgili. Bu yerda xijolat tortish ma'nosi bor.
wrong.spectacular: ajoyib, dabdabali. Bunday vaziyatga mos emas.

q: The football match was so ______ that we screamed with joy when our team scored in the final minute.
why: «screamed with joy» bu hayajonli «exciting» o'yin bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

q: The mystery novel was so ______ that I stayed up all night to finish reading it.
why: «stayed up all night to finish» bu mahliqo qiluvchi «gripping» kitob ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.confusing: tushunarsiz. O'quvchini tezroq o'qib tugatishga chorlamaydi.

q: The artist created an ______ painting of a floating city filled with colorful strange creatures.
why: «floating city filled with colorful strange creatures» bu boy tasavvurga ega «imaginative» ishdir.

wrong.unrealistic: noreal. Tasavvur kuchini maqtash ma'nosini to'liq bermaydi.
wrong.confusing: tushunarsiz. Rassomning ijodiy mahoratiga mos kelmaydi.

q: The documentary about space travel was extremely ______; I learned many fascinating facts.
why: «learned many fascinating facts» bu qiziqarli «interesting» ekanini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.embarrassing: xijolatli. Kosmos haqidagi filmga mos kelmaydi.

q: The ending of the film was so ______ that tears came to my eyes.
why: «tears came to my eyes» bu ta'sirli «moving» ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.scary: qo'rqinchli. Ko'z yosh emas, qo'rquv keltiradi.

q: The fireworks display over the city center was truly ______ with thousands of bright colors.
why: «thousands of bright colors» bu muhim va ajoyib «spectacular» tomosha ekanini bildiradi.
